name: Göreme National Park and the Rock Sites of Cappadocia
description: In central Türkiye's Nevşehir Province, Göreme National Park covers nearly 100 square kilometres of valleys carved by wind and water into strange rock formations. Byzantine monks cut chapels into the stone, and their painted interiors survive. Villagers also dug homes and whole underground towns into the rock, a way of life that goes back to the 4th century.
